label: Attribute Picker
description: Nested attribute picker with drill-down navigation.. Best for person, company and workspace fields with a type icon per row, counts on branches and a trigger path capped at 3 segments.

label: Multi-Select Cap
description: Multi-select permissions with checkboxes and a selection cap.. Best for product area permissions like billing and deployments, capped at 5, with one disabled row and a clear X over the trigger and in the footer.

label: Deep Search
description: Deep search across every level with path-annotated results.. Best for a source file tree whose search reaches files below the open folder, with folder paths telling repeated names like page.tsx apart.

label: Avatar Rows
description: Custom rows with avatars and role badges.. Best for an assignee picker by team, each member row with a photo, an online or away dot and a seniority chip, and the face repeated in the trigger.

label: Embedded Panel
description: Embedded panel without a popover.. Best for a docs table of contents searched and drilled right on the page inside a Card, with the list height capped at 240px.

label: Flat Data
description: Flat adjacency data with a parent pointer.. Best for region and department rows as a database returns them, unsorted with a parent id each, plus a footer command that resets the pick.

label: Controlled State
description: Controlled path, value, query and open state.. Best for a restaurant menu where outside code drives the open level and search text, and each commit reports its reason and full path.

label: Translated Labels
description: Translated labels across a country picker.. Best for data and chrome both in German, down to plural forms like 1 Land and 2 Länder and the arrow key hint read to screen readers.

label: Two-Line Rows
description: Two-line rows with descriptions and a disabled option.. Best for data center locations from country to city, each row a tile plus a second line of counts or region codes, with China locked.

label: Native Form Field
description: Form field that submits like a native input.. Best for an uncontrolled support topic field in a labelled form, its popup matched to the trigger width and its pick read back from FormData.

label: Columns Mode
description: Columns mode with independently scrolling panels.. Best for video, audio and article items grouped by library and collection, with a hued tile per library and a runtime chip on items and the trigger.

label: Tree Mode
description: Tree mode with inline expand and multi-select scopes.. Best for a move to destination picker whose root level splits into Recently used and All spaces, reordering each time a folder is picked.

label: Async Loading
description: Async drill-down that loads before it navigates.. Best for repositories, releases and paged release assets fetched on demand, with a toned badge per row and a button that fails the next request.

label: Virtualized List
description: Virtualized level with thousands of rows.. Best for nearly 3,000 generated sales markets with flags, a territory name and a reach badge toned by subscriber tier.

label: Removable Chips
description: Consumer-rendered removable chips with path-aware labels.. Best for a report builder that adds table columns several at a time, counting them in the trigger and listing each as a removable chip below.

label: Tree Multi-Select
description: Cascading tree multi-select inside a popover.. Best for shipping zones by continent, region and country, where 1 press takes a whole region and the trigger names top picks plus a country total.

label: Color Dots
description: Status and priority colour dots via renderLabel.. Best for workflow fields such as status, priority, severity and effort, each value marked by a colored dot that the trigger repeats beside its group.

label: Inherited Colors
description: Expense accounts with a colour inherited down each branch.. Best for a chart of accounts where any level can be booked, each row with its ledger code and spend, and the picked tile filled in place of a check.

label: Global Search
description: Global search across the whole tree from a nested level.. Best for a labelled store taxonomy preset to Headphones, with 2 Chargers rows under different branches told apart by their trail.

label: Footer Flyout
description: Pinned footer with a side-anchored import flyout.. Best for a property picker whose footer opens a flyout of 7 app and data source logos in 2 named groups.

label: Path Formatting
description: Trigger path formatting and collapsing.. Best for a connected app tree with a toggle that switches the trigger between collapsed, full, tail, leaf and a custom 2 line readout.
